jobs.description:
Human Resources Program Manager

ID

2026-18098

Category

Human Resources/Recruiting

Position Type

Full-Time Regular

Location

About Us

At Service Electric Company, we believe that each employee contributes directly to the success and growth of our company. Specializing in transmission, distribution, substation, storm restoration, and technical services., our rapid expansion follows our growing reputation for delivering safe, quality, and on-time projects to all our customers. Whether we’re staffing internal support or in-field workforce, we are guided by our Core Values of Quality, Safety, and Responsibility.

Incorporated in 1945, SERVICE ELECTRIC Company now employs over 2,000 employees and operates a fleet of more than 2,000 pieces of equipment. Our primary footprint includes the Southeast, Midwest, and Puerto Rico, but our crews travel throughout the Country to assist with storm restoration. Service Electric Company is a subsidiary of Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE:PWR).

Our culture is about supporting an environment where all employees can be themselves, are valued, and have an equal opportunity to succeed.

About this Role

The Human Resources Program Manager oversees the design, implementation, management, and tracking of specialized Human Resources programs and initiatives to ensure that they align with organization goals. This role drives continuous improvement across key HR functions, including but not limited to employee engagement and retention, training and development, and performance management.

What You'll Do

POSITION FUNCTIONS
- Partner with the Vice President of Human Resources and other company leadership to design, implement, and manage specialized HR programs and initiatives that support organizational objectives and improve the employee experience.
- Partner with members of Human Resources, company leadership, and subject matter experts to identify program needs and priorities, ensuring solutions meet the needs of the company.
- Develop project plans, timelines, and success metrics for each program, ensuring on-time and on-budget delivery.
- Analyze and utilize data to identify trends, forecast needs, and inform HR strategy and decision-making.
- Conduct and/or oversee the exit interview process for departing employees. Analyze exit interview data to identify trends, root causes of turnover, and opportunities for improvement.
- Work with the Human Resources Manager and others to ensure the onboarding program is executed from pre-hire through the first six months to create a positive employee experience.
- Support the design and implementation of career pathing programs.
- Partner with managers to create individual development plans and track progress against them.
- Identify skill gaps and learning needs across the organization in partnership with managers.
- Support the design, coordination, and evaluation of training and development programs. Track training participation.
- Lead the performance management program, partnering with managers and leadership to ensure timely, effective, and equitable performance reviews.
- Maintain and update the company handbook to reflect current policies, legal requirements, and best practices, coordinating with legal and leadership on approvals.
- Assist with Talent Acquisition, as needed.
- Plan employee engagement activities and initiatives.
- Other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS
- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, I/O Psychology or equivalent knowledge or skills obtained through a combination of education, training, and experience.
- 3+ years of Human Resources/Organizational Development or similar experience.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES
- Excellent project management skills, capable of handling multiple projects concurrently with good time management.
- Solid experience in Microsoft Office.
- Organized with a strong attention to detail.
- Strong ability to identify and solve issues.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.
- Self-motivated.
- Ability to build and foster relationships with team members.
- Ability to maintain confidentiality.
- Ability to conducts self in an appropriate manner as a representative of SEC, working effectively in a diverse work environment.

jobs.title: VP of Finance
jobs.description:
VP of Finance

ID

2026-17196

Category

Accounting & Finance

Position Type

Full-Time Regular

Location

About Us

Potelco, Inc., a subsidiary of Quanta Services, Inc.  (NYSE: PWR), was founded in 1965. We specialize in engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services, which include designing, estimating, material acquisition, project management, construction, emergency power restoration, system maintenance, and similar services. Our expertise is in power, transmission, distribution, and substation projects. We are a leading full-service provider of power infrastructure, construction, and support services in utility and energy contracting throughout the Pacific Northwest and neighboring states.

We are proud to be working with some of the region’s largest energy companies as we continue to modernize their electric systems, move towards de-carbonization, and maintain thousands of miles of overhead and underground lines serving millions of residential and commercial customers. We uphold high safety, productivity, and reliability standards as we work with our customers to provide both current and strategic, forward-thinking energy infrastructure, delivery, and solutions.

About this Role

If you enjoy working with a great group of professionals, are accurate, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy using your financial and organizational skills, then we have a role for you!

Potelco, Inc. is looking for a great VP of Finance to join our corporate team in Sumner, WA . This role provides strategic financial leadership and oversight across two business lines, partnering closely with operational and executive leadership to drive financial performance, accounting integrity, and process excellence. The VP of Finance reports to the CFO and leads a team of finance professionals supporting project accounting, month-end close, and financial reporting functions.

What You'll Do

Leadership & Strategy
· Provide financial leadership and strategic guidance across two business lines
· Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance team
· Partner with business line leaders and executive management to support operational and financial decision-making
· Drive process improvements and standardization across finance functions
Accounting & Financial Operations
· Oversee and manage the month-end close process, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
· Direct project accounting functions, including job costing, revenue recognition, and project financial performance
· Ensure compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) across all financial reporting
· Review and approve financial statements, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules
· Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis for both business lines
Reporting & Compliance
· Prepare and present financial reports and analysis to executive leadership
· Ensure internal controls are designed, implemented, and maintained effectively
· Coordinate with external auditors and support audit processes
· Ensure internal controls are designed, implemented, maintained, and in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulatory laws.
· Ensure compliance with corporate accounting policies and applicable regulations

· Other duties as assigned

What You'll Bring

Minimum Qualifications:
· Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Adminstration or related field
· 10+ years of progressive finance/accounting leadership experience
· Experience in construction, utility, or infrastructure industries
· Active CPA license
· Strong working knowledge of GAAP
· Demonstrated experience in project accounting
· Proven experience leading, developing, and managing finance teams
· Strong knowledge of month-end close processes and financial reporting
· Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
· Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
· High level of integrity and dependability, with a strong sense of urgency and results orientation.
· Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills
· Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting/ERP systems

Preferred Qualifications:
· Experience supporting multiple business lines or divisions within a single organization
· MBA or advanced finance/accounting credential

What You'll Get

· 401(k)
· 401(k) matching
· Dental insurance
· Flexible spending account
· Health insurance
· Life insurance
· Paid time off
· Vision insurance

Compensation Range

The anticipated compensation for this position is USD $170,000.00/Yr. - USD $210,000.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.

About Us

NorthStar Energy Solutions, a Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE:PWR) company, is headquartered in Grand Prairie, TX and operates across the Central Southwest part of the United States. We are leaders specializing in transmission lines, distribution lines, substation construction, foundations, storm damage repairs, and electrical contracting.

Joining our team means being part of an organization that values drive and inclusion. We focus on career development and reward excellence, recognizing each team member's unique contributions. We're at the forefront of powering modern life. Discover how your skills and dedication can make a real difference to us.

About this Role

NorthStar Energy Solutions is hiring!!

Operations Manager – Data Center Construction – Dry Utilities

The Operations Manager is responsible for the overall operational performance and execution of multiple data center construction projects. This position provides leadership and oversight to project management and field supervision while ensuring projects are executed safely, efficiently, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with company and customer expectations.

The Operations Manager serves as a key connection between field operations, project management, and company leadership. This position is responsible for maintaining visibility across projects, balancing resources, identifying operational risks, supporting project teams, and driving consistent execution standards throughout the organization.

The successful candidate will possess strong construction leadership experience, financial and operational awareness, and the ability to manage multiple projects and teams simultaneously.

What You'll Do

Operational Leadership• Support and provide direction to Project Managers, Superintendents, General Foremen, and other project leadership.
• Maintain regular communication with project teams regarding safety, schedule, manpower, cost, quality, and customer expectations.
• Ensure company policies, procedures, and operational standards are consistently implemented across projects.
• Promote accountability and a results-driven culture throughout project operations.

Project Execution
• Maintain overall visibility of project scope, schedule, budget, manpower, equipment, materials, and major milestones.
• Ensure project teams understand contractual requirements and execution expectations.
• Monitor project progress against established schedules and financial targets.
• Identify operational risks and develop mitigation or recovery strategies with project leadership.

Manpower & Resource Management
• Develop and maintain visibility of manpower requirements across all assigned projects.
• Coordinate manpower allocation based on project priorities, schedules, and available work fronts.
• Coordinate movement of key personnel between projects when required.
• Monitor workforce productivity and ensure labor resources are being effectively utilized.

Equipment & Asset Management
• Maintain visibility of major equipment requirements across projects.
• Coordinate allocation and movement of company-owned and rental equipment.
• Review equipment utilization and identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary rental costs.
• Ensure project teams properly forecast equipment requirements.
• Support planning for excavators, loaders, skid steers, forklifts, cranes, compaction equipment, trucks, and other major construction equipment.
• Promote proper care, maintenance, and accountability for company assets.

Financial Performance
• Monitor project financial performance, including revenue, cost, margin, labor performance, equipment costs, and forecasted completion.
• Participate in monthly project financial and operational reviews.
• Monitor labor productivity against estimate and budget expectations.

Schedule Management
• Maintain visibility of major project milestones and contractual completion dates.
• Ensure manpower, equipment, materials, and subcontractors are aligned with schedule requirements.
• Coordinate resources between projects based on schedule priorities.

Planning & Forecasting
• Maintain visibility of current and upcoming project workload.
• Develop operational forecasts for manpower, equipment, leadership, and other resources.
• Participate in planning for upcoming project mobilizations.
• Identify resource constraints before they impact project execution.
• Coordinate with estimating and preconstruction teams to provide field and operational input on upcoming work.
• Participate in project handoff meetings from estimating/preconstruction to operations.
• Support development of project execution strategies prior to mobilization.

Team Development
• Coach and mentor Project Managers, Superintendents, and other project leaders.
• Establish clear expectations and provide regular performance feedback.
• Identify high-performing employees and opportunities for advancement.
• Support training and development programs for field and management personnel.
• Promote succession planning for critical operational positions.

What You'll Bring

• Minimum 10 years of construction experience, preferably within electrical, underground utility, data center, or mission-critical construction.
• Minimum 5 years of construction management or operational leadership experience preferred.
• Demonstrated experience overseeing multiple construction projects simultaneously.
• Strong understanding of project financial management, including budgets, forecasts, cost-to-complete, revenue, margin, and labor productivity.
• Strong knowledge of construction scheduling, manpower planning, equipment utilization, and field operations.
• Ability to read and understand construction drawings, specifications, contracts, schedules, and project financial reports.
• Demonstrated ability to lead Project Managers, Superintendents, and field leadership.
• Strong organizational, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced construction environment.
• Ability to travel between assigned project locations as required.

What You'll Get

As a NorthStar Energy Solutions employee, we offer a wide range of benefits to meet your needs.

• 401(k) with immediate matching and vesting

jobs.title: Field Customer Success Specialist
jobs.description:
Field Customer Success Specialist

ID

2026-17195

Category

Logistics/Fleet Management

Position Type

Full-Time Regular

Location

US-

About Us

A proud member of the Quanta Services family of companies, Ampacity, LLC (Ampacity) delivers a forward-thinking approach to structural and electrical solutions for clean energy transition projects. From design, kitting, and installation to comprehensive electrical procurement, Ampacity specializes in expert-engineered, field-ready solutions that accelerate project timelines and maximize impact. Made up of more than 350 passionate professionals committed to simplifying complexity across the energy value chain, Ampacity empowers customers to build smarter, faster, and more efficiently­—with the most reliable technology in the industry. Headquartered in California, Ampacity maintains facilities in Mississippi, Kentucky, and Iowa, with offices in Florida, Georgia, and Vermont. Since 2014, Ampacity has delivered nearly eight gigawatts of fully engineered clean energy systems across North America.

About this Role

We're  adding a Field Customer Success Specialist to our Electrical team — a boots-on-the-ground role built to make sure every shipment, every count, and every customer interaction  reflects  the reliability and precision Ampacity is known for.  You'll  be the face of Ampacity on customer job sites, turning  logistics  execution into a genuine competitive advantage and building the kind of trust that keeps customers coming back.
This  isn't  a back-office  logistics  role.  You'll  be on-site with customers, in the field, solving problems in real time and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between the warehouse and the job site.
Pay Range: $25- $30/hourly
Travel: ~ 80%

Typical Work Environment
- Active solar construction sites with heavy machinery, power tools, and construction equipment in operation.

- 100% outdoor work environment subject to extreme weather conditions including snow and high heat, with exposure to dust, fumes, noise, and uneven terrain.

- Work at various heights requiring fall protection equipment.

- Position may require unexpected travel and relocation to project sites with short notice.

What You'll Do

- Provide onsite support for customers as they receive electrical goods ( eBOS ) and material shipments

- Execute physical counts and inventory verification against purchase orders and packing lists

- Identify  shortages, damages, or missing items and drive fast,  accurate  resolution

- Manage and track RMAs (Return Merchandise Authorizations) from initiation through closure

- Serve as the customer's trusted point of contact on-site — answering questions, flagging issues early, and keeping projects moving

- Partner with internal project management,  logistics , and sales teams to resolve discrepancies quickly

- Document site visits, counts, and resolutions with clear, consistent reporting

- Build long-term relationships that make Ampacity the easy, obvious choice for repeat business

- Travel to customer and project sites as needed, up to approximately 80% of the time

- This role will evolve over time with the needs of the business.

What You'll Bring

- Experience in  logistics , warehousing, materials management, construction, or field services (electrical/solar industry experience a strong plus)

- Comfort working independently on job sites and managing your own schedule and travel

- Sharp attention to detail - comfortable with physical counts, documentation, and reconciliation

- Strong communication  skills; able to build rapport quickly with customers and internal teams

- A proactive, ownership mindset - you spot problems before they become customer issues

- Willingness and ability to travel up to 80%, including some overnight and multi-day trips

- Valid driver's license; comfort working outdoors and on active construction/job sites

- Familiarity with basic inventory or ERP systems is a plus

What You'll Get

- Competitive pay and 401k — because your work should be rewarded fairly

- Time off  you'll  actually  use:  vacation, sick days, holidays, parental, and bereavement leave

- Full medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus extra support when you need it

- Wellness resources to help you show up as your best self, at work and at home

- Real room to grow — we promote from within and invest in your development

About Us

NorthStar Energy Solutions, a Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE:PWR) company, is headquartered in Grand Prairie, TX and operates across the Central Southwest part of the United States. We are leaders specializing in transmission lines, distribution lines, substation construction, foundations, storm damage repairs, and electrical contracting.

Joining our team means being part of an organization that values drive and inclusion. We focus on career development and reward excellence, recognizing each team member's unique contributions. We're at the forefront of powering modern life. Discover how your skills and dedication can make a real difference to us.

About this Role

NorthStar Energy Solutions is hiring! The Claims & Risk Manager is responsible for leading NorthStar Energy Solutions’ incident-to-claim lifecycle, working directly with the Safety and Regional Risk teams to assess, manage, and influence claim outcomes. This role applies adjuster-level expertise to evaluate incident severity, determine exposure, and ensure all claims are supported by accurate, thorough, and defensible documentation.

What You'll Do

- Lead the evaluation of incidents from initial report through claim submission, applying professional judgment to assess liability, severity, and exposure.
- Partner directly with Safety and Regional Risk teams to ensure incidents are properly investigated, documented, and positioned to support favorable claim outcomes.
- Review and validate all incident and claim documentation for accuracy, completeness, and defensibility prior to submission.
- Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and risk factors in reporting; work with field teams to resolve deficiencies and strengthen claim quality.
- Oversee timely reporting and submission of claims to carriers and TPAs in accordance with policy requirements and deadlines.
- Monitor active claims for escalation indicators, high-exposure risks, and trends; provide insight and recommendations to Regional Risk leadership.
- Participate in claim reviews, strategy discussions, and audits, contributing analysis and documentation to support claim outcomes.
- Maintain organized, audit-ready files to support claims, litigation, and insurance compliance requirements.
- Drive continuous improvement in incident reporting processes, documentation standards, and risk controls to reduce claim frequency and severity.

What You'll Bring

- Job Requirements
- 3+ years of claims handling, insurance adjusting, or risk management experience required.
- Adjuster experience strongly preferred (carrier, TPA, or self-insured environment).
- Strong understanding of liability determination, claims lifecycle, and insurance practices.
- Proven ability to assess risk exposure and influence claim outcomes through investigation and documentation.
- Strong analytical, investigative, and decision-making skills.
- High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and defensibility.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and claims/document management systems.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to coordinate across field teams, leadership, and external partners.

Skills Requirements:
- Possess critical thinking skills.
- Able to effectively communicate with others.
- Ability to communicate in writing.

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Business, Safety, or related field preferred.
- Experience supporting or partnering with Safety teams in high-risk industries (construction, utilities, energy) preferred.
